tickets.title: Set up the repo layout
tickets.description: libworldforge, forge-cli, data, viewer, game, tools. data/ shared between generator and game as single source of truth.

tickets.title: Create the UE 5.8 project with module split
tickets.description: Core, Gameplay, WorldRuntime, UI rather than one monolith. Cheapest compile-time win; miserable to retrofit.

tickets.title: WorldForge UE plugin scaffold
tickets.description: Wraps libworldforge and owns the phase 12 bake. Compiles separately, stays cleanly bounded.

tickets.title: forge-cli wrapper
tickets.description: PNGs, manifest output, batch runs. The iteration surface for all world design.

tickets.title: Local web map viewer
tickets.description: Node 22 plus canvas. Toggleable overlays for elevation, biomes, rivers, roads, territory, POIs, contested cells. The tool you'll use most.

tickets.title: Batch seed harness
tickets.description: Run 1,000 seeds through phases 0-11 and report validation-gate failures by cause. Catches over-constrained axioms before players do.

tickets.title: JSON to UE DataAsset import tool
tickets.description: Author in JSON (diffable, generator-readable), import at build time so the editor experience stays good.

tickets.title: Data cross-reference validator
tickets.description: Does every axiom's biome injection reference a real biome? Does every synergy reference real axioms?

tickets.title: CI: determinism, golden images, save round-trip
tickets.description: The three tests that matter. Determinism runs on every commit.

tickets.title: Content folder convention enforcement
tickets.description: Organise by feature, not asset type. Type-based folders stop scaling around the thousandth asset.

tickets.title: Evaluate Perforce migration trigger
tickets.description: Switch when LFS operations cost minutes rather than seconds — typically a few tens of GB of content. Do not adopt pre-emptively.

tickets.title: Compile time budget review
tickets.description: Module boundaries, forward declarations, header bloat. The daily tax matters more than almost any technical decision over years.

tickets.title: Plugin dependency policy
tickets.description: Every third-party plugin can block a 5.8 to 5.9 migration. Current decisions leave the project needing almost none — protect that.
